SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - SKL-242 - not real data
"""Ledger part %NN%: validated totals for a synthetic batch of entries, with negative amounts refused."""

# HUNK-ONLY-MARKER-%NN%-A: this line exists only in the head and so only inside a changed hunk.
DEFAULT_LIMIT_%NN% = 250
SEPARATOR_%NN% = ","


class EntryError_%NN%(ValueError):
    """Raised when a ledger line cannot be read as a name and a non-negative whole amount."""


def parse_entry_%NN%(line, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    parts = [part.strip() for part in line.split(separator)]
    if len(parts) != 2 or not parts[0]:
        raise EntryError_%NN%("part %NN%: expected 'name,amount', got %r" % (line,))
    name, raw_amount = parts
    if not raw_amount.isdigit():
        raise EntryError_%NN%("part %NN%: amount must be a non-negative whole number: %r" % (raw_amount,))
    return name, int(raw_amount)


def parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    entries = []
    for number, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            continue
        try:
            entries.append(parse_entry_%NN%(line, separator))
        except EntryError_%NN% as error:
            raise EntryError_%NN%("line %d: %s" % (number, error)) from error
    return entries


def total_%NN%(lines, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    # HUNK-ONLY-MARKER-%NN%-B: the total now skips blank and comment lines before summing.
    return sum(amount for _, amount in parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator))


def largest_%NN%(lines, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    entries = parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator)
    if not entries:
        return None
    return max(entries, key=lambda entry: (entry[1], entry[0]))


def over_limit_%NN%(lines, limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT_%NN%, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    return [(name, amount) for name, amount in parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator) if amount > limit]


def summary_%NN%(lines, limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT_%NN%, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    entries = parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator)
    flagged = [name for name, amount in entries if amount > limit]
    # HUNK-ONLY-MARKER-%NN%-C: the summary now names the flagged entries.
    return "part %NN%: %d entries, total %d, over %d: %s" % (
        len(entries), sum(amount for _, amount in entries), limit, ", ".join(flagged) or "none")


def average_%NN%(lines, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    entries = parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator)
    if not entries:
        raise EntryError_%NN%("part %NN%: no entries to average")
    return sum(amount for _, amount in entries) // len(entries)


def names_%NN%(lines, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    seen = set()
    ordered = []
    for name, _ in parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator):
        if name not in seen:
            seen.add(name)
            ordered.append(name)
    return ordered


def report_%NN%(lines, limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT_%NN%, separator=SEPARATOR_%NN%):
    entries = parsed_entries_%NN%(lines, separator)
    width = max((len(name) for name, _ in entries), default=0)
    rows = ["%-*s %8d%s" % (width, name, amount, "  over" if amount > limit else "")
            for name, amount in sorted(entries)]
    rows.append(summary_%NN%(lines, limit, separator))
    return "\n".join(rows) + "\n"
